response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform experience; their work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with only brief C++ exposure in academic or minor roles, and no evidence of leading cloud compute platforms or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers as required.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Demonstrated leadership in open-source projects and technical mentoring through workshops and talks
Proven ability to build and deploy scalable systems using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
concerns: Only minimal C++ experience documented, far below the 8-year minimum requirement
No evidence of leading cloud compute platforms, distributed systems, or hardware architecture at scale
Lacks documented technical leadership in cloud or DevOps engineering mentoring roles
